name: King's College London
indiaReqNote: CBSE/CISCE Class XII only. ~80% overall generally considered for direct entry; 90%+ advantageous for highly competitive programmes; ~85% in required subjects. Exact per-course figures are on course pages (not verified per course). UNVERIFIED: taken from search summary, not a fetched official page.
tuitionNote: International fee varies by course; not verifiable from official KCL pages (course fee pages did not render).
deadlines: UCAS mid-January equal-consideration deadline (Oct 15 for Medicine/Dentistry/Vet)

name: University of Leeds
indiaReqNote: Overall average across Standard XII. Range published as 60-85% overall with 75-90% in two relevant subjects. For AAA courses (CBSE/CISCE): 75% overall incl. 80% in two academic non-maths subjects, min 70% English & Maths; AAB: 70% overall. State boards ~5% higher.
tuitionNote: Computer Science BSc international fee £33,700/yr (shown on 2027-entry course page, fixed for course duration). Classroom-based courses likely lower; full range not verified.
deadlines: UCAS mid-January equal-consideration deadline (Oct 15 for Medicine/Dentistry/Vet)

name: University of Manchester
indiaReqNote: CBSE/ISC: minimum 80-95% overall depending on course, plus subject-specific requirements. Basis (all vs best subjects) not specified. Foundation year: 70% overall.
tuitionNote: UNCERTAIN: search summary of manchester.ac.uk pages cited £33,100 (2026/27, course unspecified) and £35,200 (BSc IT for Business Management); fees vary by course. Midpoint of those two.
deadlines: UCAS mid-January equal-consideration deadline (Oct 15 for Medicine/Dentistry/Vet)

name: University of Warwick
indiaReqNote: Average across 5 subjects (CBSE/ISC). A*A*A+ = 92%, A*AA = 90%, AAA = 85%, AAB = 83%, ABB = 80%. CBSE Applied Maths not accepted for CS, Maths, Statistics.
tuitionNote: 2026/27 overseas bands: Band 1 £27,870 (humanities/social sciences), Band 2 £35,530 (STEM, Economics, Management, Psychology). Medicine separate.
deadlines: UCAS mid-January equal-consideration deadline (Oct 15 for Medicine/Dentistry/Vet)

name: University College London
indiaReqNote: CBSE/CISCE Standard 12, per-subject mapping: A* = 95, A = 90, B = 85 in examination subjects; e.g. A*AA = 95,95,95,90,90 across five subjects. Typical = AAA-level programmes, high = A*AA/A*A*A.
tuitionNote: UCL fee schedule page returned 403; not verified.
deadlines: UCAS mid-January equal-consideration deadline (Oct 15 for Medicine/Dentistry/Vet)

name: Imperial College London
indiaReqNote: Official minimum: 90% overall across five subjects with 90% in relevant subjects (CBSE/CISCE). Some courses higher; 'high' of 92% (with 90-95% in Maths/sciences) is from a search summary of imperial.ac.uk, not fully verified. English 70% in Class XII needed.
tuitionNote: 2026/27 overseas fee for all Faculty of Engineering departments (incl. Computing) is £45,500; other faculties vary, Medicine higher.
deadlines: UCAS mid-January equal-consideration deadline (Oct 15 for Medicine/Dentistry/Vet)

name: University of Edinburgh
indiaReqNote: Minimum requirements: Arts/Humanities/Social Sciences 80% overall with three subjects at 75%; Science & Engineering 80% overall and 80% in required subjects; Medicine/Vet 85% overall. No separate competitive threshold published.
tuitionNote: Fees listed per programme in degree finder; not extracted. Fixed annual fee for international students.
deadlines: UCAS mid-January equal-consideration deadline (Oct 15 for Medicine/Vet)

name: London School of Economics and Political Science
indiaReqNote: CBSE/CISCE only. A*AA = 95%+ overall average with 3 subjects at 95%+; AAA = 90%+ overall with 5 subjects at 90%+; AAB = 85%+. 95% Maths where A* Maths required; Applied Maths not accepted from 2027/28 for Maths programmes.
tuitionNote: 2026/27 overseas UG fee for new entrants £28,900-£30,700 by programme tier (fixed for duration).
deadlines: UCAS mid-January equal-consideration deadline (Oct 15 for Medicine/Dentistry/Vet)

name: University of Bristol
indiaReqNote: CBSE/CISCE typical offers range from 80% (ABB) to 90% (A*AA); varies by course and subjects. Many departments accept CBSE/CISCE English at 80%+ with MOI letter. From search summary of bristol.ac.uk India page (direct fetch blocked).
tuitionNote: 2026/27 overseas starters: £25,500 (Law) to £33,400 (Computer Science, Psychology); Economics/History £28,200. Excludes Medicine/Dentistry/Vet.
deadlines: UCAS mid-January equal-consideration deadline (Oct 15 for Medicine/Dentistry/Vet)

name: University of Glasgow
indiaReqNote: CBSE and ISC overall score: A*AA = 85%, AAA = 80%, AAB/ABB/BBB = 75%. State boards higher (up to 90% for A*AA). Medicine/Dentistry/Vet assessed separately.
tuitionNote: 2026/27 international: £27,720 (Arts & Social Sciences) to £33,210 (Science, Engineering, Nursing, Life Sciences). MBChB £62,730, BDS £58,500.
deadlines: UCAS mid-January equal-consideration deadline (Oct 15 for Medicine/Dentistry/Vet)

name: University of Nottingham
indiaReqNote: Average of four highest graded Class XII subjects (CBSE/CISCE). A*AA = 93%, AAA = 90%, AAB = 87%, ABB = 84%, BBB = 80%. CBSE/CISCE English 85% meets the highest English requirement.
tuitionNote: 2026/27 UK campus international: £24,700 (History) to £34,000 (Sport Rehabilitation); Computer Science £33,000; Economics/Law £26,800. Excludes Medicine/Vet and foundation years.
deadlines: UCAS mid-January equal-consideration deadline (Oct 15 for Medicine/Dentistry/Vet)

name: University of Southampton
indiaReqNote: At least 75% from CBSE/CISCE/Metro State Boards as baseline; exact per-course percentages on course pages (not extracted), so 'high' is null.
tuitionNote: 2026/27 overseas: £26,800 (Nursing & Midwifery) to £34,100 (Chemistry, Physics, Audiology); Computer Science £33,000; Economics £28,300; Law £28,400. Excludes Medicine.
